title: Ingredient Script
content:
Extends: Form Script
Editor: Ingredient Script that represents an alchemy ingredient. Definition: ScriptName Ingredient extends Form Native Hidden Properties: None Global Functions: None Member Functions: - bool Function IsHostile() Returns whether this ingredient is considered hostile or not. - Function LearnEffect(int aiIndex) Flags the effect with the given index as known by the player. - int Function LearnNextEffect() Flags the next unknown effect as known by the player, returning index of learned effect. - Function LearnAllEffects() Flags the all effects as known by the player. Events: None
